

```{r}
trigli=c(142.3, 144.0, 148.6, 146.9, 142.9, 147.4, 133.8,
133.2, 134.9, 146.3, 145.2, 146.3, 125.9, 127.6,
108.9, 107.5, 148.6, 156.5, 148.6, 153.1, 135.5,
138.9, 132.1, 149.7, 152.0, 151.4, 149.7, 152.0,
142.9, 142.3, 141.7, 141.2)
dia=factor(rep(1:4,each=8))
maq=factor(rep(c("A","B","C","D"),4,each=2))
```


$$H_0: \mu_{1\bullet} = \mu_{2\bullet} = \mu_{3\bullet} = \mu_{4\bullet}$$

```{r}
library(lme4)
mod1=lmer(trigli~1+maq+(1|dia))
drop1(mod1, test = "Chisq")
#mod1_int=lmer(trigli~1+maq+(1|dia)+(1|dia:maq))
```



```{r}
mod1=lmer(trigli~1+maq+(1|dia), REML = F)
mod2=lmer(trigli~1+(1|dia), REML = F)
LRT=-2*logLik(mod2)+2*logLik(mod1)
p = pchisq(LRT,3, lower.tail = F)
cat("Prueba de razón de verosimilitud", LRT, "\nProbabilidad de la prueba chi-cuadrado es", p)
```
